name: Majik 4
english_description: A real MudOS v21/v22-era mudlib from 1998-1999, the fourth incarnation of hobbyist author Tero Ilkka Leino's ("namhas") Majik project and the direct successor to majik3 (also in this collection). Genuinely distinct architecture from majik3: a grid-based ('roguelike') gameworld instead of room objects, and a custom structured text wire protocol (command-code:length:data framing, a real graphical client protocol) rather than plain telnet commands -- confirmed fully scriptable over a plain socket (not a WASM-only limitation) via a raw client that logs in, selects a race, and walks into real hand-built content (Hilltop Village, with NPCs, an inn, a bank). The archive's own README candidly says development stopped when the base code was 'almost, still not even beta' -- and indeed its real procedural terrain generator was a native MudOS C driver package (majik_mapgen.c) never built into this project's FluffOS, which without a stub would have permanently blocked every character from ever entering the game world (every new character's starting-location fallback routes through the generator). Fixed during onboarding: added the required get_root_uid()/get_bb_uid()/creator_file() master applies (absent from this archive's master.lpc, unlike majik3's own secure/secure.lpc), created the missing work/log and work/binaries runtime directories, added a clearly-labeled minimal generate_map() compatibility stub (flat single-terrain fill, not the original's blended algorithm -- a real, permanent content-fidelity gap, not a bug that got 'fixed'), and corrected two independent one-character typos (an extra closing paren in command/mortal/throw.lpc, and a Finnish-author false-friend NUM_VOCALS/NUM_VOWELS typo in world/bral_gaur/genwords.lpc). See libs/majik4/NOTES.md and AGENTS.md #7.160 for the full writeup. See also majik3, the same author's 1997-1998 predecessor project.
